observations.question: What two-wheeler purchase incentive rate, battery capacity limit, ex-factory price ceiling, policy period and scheme-stacking conditions did the 2021 policy state?

result.answer:
Gujarat — source cutoff: 2026-09-23.

Prototype source review is pending; current availability and individual eligibility are not verified.

- Purchase incentive rate for two‑wheelers is an effective tax rate of 1 % of the vehicle cost (existing 6 %, rebate 5 %). [S8](https://egazette.gujarat.gov.in/ViewPdf2.aspx?docid=202504210834101619.pdf&cdbid=04b1daad51e67cccdfe90fc07bb46679&contentType=application/pdf#page=2)
- Battery capacity limit for the two‑wheelers subsidy is 2 kWh as listed in column (2) of Table 2; the actual capacity figures appear in column (3) but the policy refers to column (2). [S4](https://www.powermin.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/3c383a891d96404e4b137b9e1ceb9ff9.pdf#page=5)
- Maximum ex‑factory price to qualify for the two‑wheelers demand‑incentive subsidy is Rs 1.5 lakhs. [S4](https://www.powermin.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/3c383a891d96404e4b137b9e1ceb9ff9.pdf#page=5)
- The 2021 policy was operative for four years commencing 1 July 2021 (i.e., until 30 June 2025). [S4](https://www.powermin.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/3c383a891d96404e4b137b9e1ceb9ff9.pdf#page=5) [S5](https://www.powermin.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/3c383a891d96404e4b137b9e1ceb9ff9.pdf#page=4)
- State‑level scheme‑stacking: a beneficiary may claim the demand‑incentive subsidy under only one Gujarat state scheme and cannot claim multiple state subsidies. [S4](https://www.powermin.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/3c383a891d96404e4b137b9e1ceb9ff9.pdf#page=5)
- Central‑level scheme‑stacking: the state demand incentive is payable over and above any central‑government subsidies such as FAME II. [S4](https://www.powermin.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/3c383a891d96404e4b137b9e1ceb9ff9.pdf#page=5)

Sources:

- [S8: Gujarat — Gujarat motor vehicle tax notification GH/PT/2025/13, PDF page 2](https://egazette.gujarat.gov.in/ViewPdf2.aspx?docid=202504210834101619.pdf&cdbid=04b1daad51e67cccdfe90fc07bb46679&contentType=application/pdf#page=2)
- [S4: Gujarat — Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy 2021, PDF page 5](https://www.powermin.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/3c383a891d96404e4b137b9e1ceb9ff9.pdf#page=5)
- [S5: Gujarat — Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy 2021, PDF page 4](https://www.powermin.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/3c383a891d96404e4b137b9e1ceb9ff9.pdf#page=4)

sources.version_note: 2025 tax table, read with the mandatory 30 March 2026 amendment. Original Match 2026 typo/deadline is superseded by 31 March 2027. Rebates differ by vehicle category; all listed effective rates are 1% of vehicle cost. This does not extend cash purchase subsidies.

2021 policy: four years from 1 July 2021 (end 30 June 2025 inferred). No purchase/charging extension established; later tax notification is separate. Clause 8(iv) prints column (2), while battery capacity is in column (3); retain this discrepancy. Amounts are printed per kWh, not as lump-sum caps. When describing the battery limit, distinguish the maximum subsidised capacity from vehicle eligibility: Table 2/8(iv) does not expressly disqualify a larger battery. Explicitly flag that 8(iv) says column (2) but the battery values are actually in column (3); never repeat the wrong reference as a correct table description. Use past tense for the expired 2021 purchase provisions.

7. SCOPE AND ELIGIBILITY

(i) The Policy shall be applicable to all classes of electric vehic les that have taken subsidy under
the Government of India’s FAME II scheme dated 8th March 2019, F. No 1(1)/2019‐AEI and
any amendments thereafter.

(ii) The incentives for setting up a charging station shall be applicable to charging stations
meeting the guidelines and standards of the Ministry of Power Circular, dated 1st October,
2019 and any amendments thereafter.
8. INCENTIVES FOR EARLY ADOPTION OF ELECTRIC VEHICLES

(i) The Demand Incentive from the State shall be over and above any subsidies that are available
from the Central Government through its promotional schemes and policies. The subsidy shall
be disbursed directly to the customer via DBT mode from the Sta te Transport Department on
authenticating the document for the purchase of the vehicle.

(ii) The incentives for all types of electric vehicles shall be based on the electric vehicle battery
capacity (i.e energy content measured in kWh). The threshold pr ice to avail the subsidy for
each vehicle segment shall be as per Government of India’s FAME II scheme dated 8th March
2019, F. No 1(1)/2019‐AEI and any amendments thereafter.

Table 2: Summary of incentive across all segments under the policy period

Srl.No. Vehicle Segment Battery State Subsidy Amount Maximum ex‐factory
Capacity (in Rs.) price to avail
(kWh) incentive (in Rs.)

(1) (2) (3) (4) (5)

1 2 wheeler 2 Rs. 10,000/‐ per kWh Rs. 1.5 lakhs

2 3 wheeler 5 Rs. 10,000/‐ per kWh Rs. 5 lakhs

3 4‐Wheeler 15 Rs. 10,000/‐ per kWh Rs.15 lakhs

(iii) The beneficiary can opt to get one time subsidy under any one scheme of the state
government runs by the different departments. the beneficiary can not claim subsidy under
more than one scheme of the state government.

(iv) The maximum amount of subsidy for any Vehicle is limited to the maximum battery capacity
of the vehicle shown in column (2) of the Table 2

9. INCENTIVES FOR CHARGING INFRASTRUCTURE

(i) The State Government shall promote charging infrastructure of different capacities/
technologies and promote a variety of business models. Privately‐owned, DisCom‐owned and
Investor‐owned charging and battery swapping stations are encouraged under this Policy.

Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy ‐ 2021. 3
